ambiguity_traps_catalogued: commercial P13 (Self-Referencing Pressure Sensor, historical P-27-R1, portfolio folder 13) vs HISTORICAL P-13 (Adaptive Valve, portfolio folder 02) — a reader seeing 'P-13' can be misled into the wrong technology
commercial P04 (Drainage Floor, historical P-07, folder 04) vs HISTORICAL P-04 (Catalytic Clearance, portfolio folder 03)

remediation_path: The commercial-designation migration of the buyer surface is an Art. XXXIX RELEASE-CHAIN OPERATION, not a working-tree edit: both repos clean and pushed at HEAD == origin/main BEFORE the build; release content committed and pushed to the buyer-distribution repository FIRST (buyer docs regenerated with commercial designations as primary identity lines and historical IDs demoted to provenance fields); CANONICAL_RELEASE_MANIFEST regenerated from the pushed state; ENGINE_RELEASE_REGISTRY entry recorded; clean-clone verification of the four agreeing states. The engine already carries the authoritative mapping (LEAD_PORTFOLIO_IDENTITY_REGISTRY.json) the regeneration would consume. This round records the gap; it does not perform the release.
